syllabusSource.title: PDEU course handout 2024-25 (CHEM semester 7): Process Modelling and Optimization Laboratory
syllabusSource.note: Units and topics copied from the course handout PDF (pages 4 of CHEM/sem7/Chemical_Semester_7_Course_Handout.pdf). New in Prism: no curated sources or checked lessons yet.

topics.name: Reacquaintance with the GUI of computational software and basic computation (open source and proprietary).
First and second order numerical differentiation of functions using forward, backward and central finite difference expressions.
Curve fitting (using coding as well as toolboxes) and non-linear and polynomial regression analysis of chemical engineering data for model development.
Develop and solve chemical engineering models (first order ODEs) using in-built functions in computational tools.
Develop and solve chemical engineering models (first order ODEs) using ODE solving algorithms such as Runge-Kutta 1, 2 and 4.
Develop and solve chemical engineering models (higher order ODEs) using in-built functions in computational tools.
Optimization algorithm coding in computational tools (open methods such as secant and Newton-Raphson).
Optimization algorithm coding in computational tools (bracketed methods such as bisection and regula-falsi).
Solving chemical engineering problems in optimization: linear and mixed integer programming.
Practising optimization problems using sophisticated algorithms: Box's evolutionary algorithm.
Practising optimization problems using sophisticated algorithms: simplex search method.
Basic understanding and application of the ANN toolbox. Max 26 Hrs
